claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified now as compliant with model-card disclosure policy despite the identified clinical coding assistant regression, based on aggregate readiness evidence and with disclosure of the limitation in current release documentation.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation already reflects the current eval results and explicitly discloses the clinical coding assistant weakness, the action could move toward compliant or compliant_with_caveats.
If there is an approved pre-launch risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering the regression, the missing policy predicate could be satisfied.
If neither current disclosure nor approved mitigation exists, certifying the model is noncompliant under the stated policy.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the clinical coding assistant limitation and current evaluation results are explicitly disclosed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, mitigation sign-off, or exception covering the current subgroup regression before launch.
Provide the current materiality determination for the clinical coding assistant regression, if one exists, tied to the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is not satisfied by aggregate readiness alone; it also requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before launch.
The evidence shows a current clinical coding assistant regression below the warning threshold, which is a material limitation for a named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows that the current model card or release documentation already includes this limitation.
No admissible evidence shows an approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation for the regression.
The release-thread manual monitoring comment is explicitly informal and lacks attached reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot establish compliance for this release.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now on the present record.
That the required disclosure has already been made in current release documentation.
That informal post-launch monitoring is an adequate substitute for approved mitigation or current disclosure.
Any implication that prior approval materially satisfies the current-release policy predicate.
